_readme2: Two sections: quick_run (daily, single param set) and param_sweep (monthly, all combos)
_quick_run_comment: Single fixed parameter set. Change these values to update your default daily run.
_watch_symbols_comment: Specific symbols to run. Empty list [] = ALL symbols. Example: ['TCS','WIPRO','INFY']
_param_sweep_comment: Arrays of values. Every combination is tested. MaxBuys(4) × BuyDrop(4) × Target(5) × Stoploss(5) × MaxDuration(5) = 2000 trade combos.

param_sweep._watch_symbols_comment: Specific symbols to run for monthly sweep. Empty list [] = ALL symbols.

filter._comment: Filter ranges. All combinations tested. Invalid combos (min>=max) auto-skipped.

trade._comment: Trade param ranges. All combos tested per filter combo.
